items.title: Pay outstanding invoice for Sideboard "Linnea"
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den offenen Betrag bitte bis Freitag, 28.08.2026.
items.computation: The letter is a company payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung), not an authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies. It states a fixed calendar date in full: 'bis Freitag, 28.08.2026'. 28.08.2026 falls on a Friday (confirmed by the letter itself and by the calendar), which is a regular business day in NW (no public holiday), so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed. The due date is simply the printed date.

warnings: This is a payment reminder from a furniture retailer (not a German authority), so no statutory deemed-delivery or objection-period rules apply — the printed date of 28.08.2026 is simply the company's own requested payment date.

The stated due date (28.08.2026) has already passed relative to today's date (2026-09-30); if unpaid, expect a further reminder or dunning fees, and check whether payment was actually made in the meantime as the letter itself suggests ('Sollten Sie inzwischen bezahlt haben ... bitten Sie, diese Erinnerung zu ignorieren').

The IBAN printed (DE02 3705 0198 0002 5090 90) is well-formed and passes the checksum, but a valid IBAN does not confirm the account belongs to Beispiel Wohnwelt GmbH — compare it with the account used on the original order/invoice before paying.
